office_does: The Treasurer provides banking, investment, debt and cash management services for the county and all local governments within it except cities.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Incumbent Treasurer Jeff Gadman (Prefers Democratic Party), appointed in 2017, is the only candidate on the ballot.

candidates.summary: Treasurer since 2017, formerly in the Assessor's Office and on the Lacey City Council, running unopposed.
highlights: Treasurer since 2017; 39 years with Thurston County [S1]
Says the county investment pool returned more than $43 million to local governments in 2025 [S1]
